_comment: Upstream sources, pinned by full commit SHA. Changing a pin requires re-reading the diff, regenerating the patches and updating LICENSES/ and docs/EDITORS.md.

i18n._comment: Interface translations for WordCraft (craft-i18n, MIT OR Apache-2.0). The commit is the one WordCraft itself pins in craft-i18n.rev; build.mjs verifies they match.

dictionary._comment: Brazilian Portuguese Hunspell dictionary (VERO), bundled UNMODIFIED. Licence: LGPLv3 / MPL (README_pt_BR.txt). Files are verified by SHA-256.
